events.title: Western Kentucky vs. Kennesaw State
events.addr: 1605 Avenue of Champions, Bowling Green, KY 42101
events.blurb: WKU Hilltoppers football closes its regular season at home against Kennesaw State, with a noon kickoff on ESPN platforms.
events.blurbEs: Los Hilltoppers de WKU cierran su temporada regular de fútbol americano en casa contra Kennesaw State, con patada inicial al mediodía por plataformas de ESPN.

events.title: SoKY Ice Rink
events.blurb: Downtown's seasonal skating rink, under the SoKY Marketplace Pavilion behind SKyPAC. Skate rental is included, kids under 12 skate for $10, and children under 4 are free.
events.blurbEs: La pista de patinaje de temporada del centro, bajo el SoKY Marketplace Pavilion detrás de SKyPAC. El alquiler de patines está incluido, los menores de 12 pagan $10 y los menores de 4 entran gratis.
events.getThere: Entrances on Center Street and 6th Street, behind SKyPAC.

events.title: Small Business Saturday Holiday Market
events.addr: 175 Iron Skillet Ct, Bowling Green, KY 42104
events.blurb: Local crafters, artisans, bakers and authors sell their own work at the Warren County Public Library's free holiday market.
events.blurbEs: Artesanos, reposteros y autores locales venden sus propias creaciones en el mercado navideño gratuito de la Warren County Public Library.

events.title: National Corvette Museum
events.blurb: More than 80 Corvettes, the famous sinkhole exhibit and racing simulators. Youth ages 5 to 12 pay $14, and kids 4 and under are free.
events.blurbEs: Más de 80 Corvettes, la famosa exposición del socavón y simuladores de carreras. Los jóvenes de 5 a 12 años pagan $14 y los niños de 4 años o menos entran gratis.

events.title: Fountain Square Park
events.blurb: The historic town square, decorated for the holidays.
events.blurbEs: La plaza histórica, decorada para las fiestas.
